note: 「练」页的阶段小题（《第四轮设计》第三节）。进入新阶段、或撞上 trigger 写的现象时，「练」页曲线上方弹一张小题卡：一个问题、三个选项。选对：+¥ 小奖励，卡片翻面显示解答，并在科技树上把对应节点圈出来。选错：显示解答，不扣钱。每题只出一次，做过的收进科技树「图鉴」。题和解答都要短：问题 ≤ 20 字，选项 ≤ 10 字，解答 ≤ 2 句。

quizzes.q: 它现在能学会什么？
quizzes.qEn: What can it learn right now?
quizzes.explain: 一层脑子只能画一条线，把题分成两边：是，或否。
quizzes.explainEn: One layer draws one line and splits questions into two sides: yes or no.

quizzes.q: 分数为什么卡在 50% 不动？
quizzes.qEn: Why is the score stuck at 50%?
quizzes.explain: 有些题要两个条件一起看才分得开，一条直线做不到。加一层就行。
quizzes.explainEn: Some questions need two clues together; one straight line can't do that. Add a layer.

quizzes.q: 练过的题全对，新题却错，为什么？
quizzes.qEn: Practice questions all right, new ones wrong. Why?
quizzes.explain: 它记住了答案，没记住规律。多给它不同的题。
quizzes.explainEn: It memorised answers, not the rule. Give it more varied questions.

quizzes.q: 步子开到最大，会怎样？
quizzes.qEn: What happens at the biggest step size?
quizzes.explain: 一次改太多，脑子里的数就乱了。快要到顶时换小步。
quizzes.explainEn: Change too much at once and the numbers scramble. Use small steps near the top.

quizzes.q: 多加几层有什么用？
quizzes.qEn: What do extra layers do?
quizzes.explain: 第一层看笔画，第二层把笔画拼成字。层越多，能想越复杂的事。
quizzes.explainEn: Layer one sees strokes, layer two joins them into characters. More layers, harder thoughts.

quizzes.q: 层加到 5 层以上，为什么不涨了？
quizzes.qEn: Why no gain past five layers?
quizzes.explain: 误差每往回传一层就缩小一截，传到底就没了。换 ReLU 就不缩了。
quizzes.explainEn: The error shrinks every layer it travels back. ReLU stops the shrinking.

quizzes.q: 数字挪一格它就不认识了，为什么？
quizzes.qEn: Move a digit one cell and it's lost. Why?
quizzes.explain: 它把每个格子当成不同的线索。用小窗口到处找同一个笔画，就不怕挪了。
quizzes.explainEn: It treats every pixel as a different clue. A small sliding window finds the stroke anywhere.

quizzes.q: 看图和读句子，为什么要两种脑型？
quizzes.qEn: Why two brain types for pictures and sentences?
options: 一个看邻居，一个看前文
optionsEn: One sees neighbours, one sees what came before
quizzes.explain: 图里有用的是旁边的像素，句子里有用的是前面的字。
quizzes.explainEn: In a picture the useful clue is the neighbouring pixel; in a sentence, the earlier words.

quizzes.q: 七言诗它总忘前面的字，怎么办？
quizzes.qEn: It forgets the start of long poem lines. Fix?
quizzes.explain: 普通循环每走一步记忆就淡一点。门控记忆自己决定留什么。
quizzes.explainEn: A plain loop fades a little every step. Gated memory decides what to keep.

quizzes.q: 屏幕一串 NaN，是什么意思？
quizzes.qEn: A screen of NaN. What does it mean?
quizzes.explain: 一步改太猛，数变成了「不是数」。限住每步的大小（梯度裁剪），再回档。
quizzes.explainEn: One step too big turned the numbers into Not-a-Number. Clip each step, then roll back.

quizzes.q: 题只有几十道，怎么防它背答案？
quizzes.qEn: Only a few dozen questions. How to stop memorising?
quizzes.explain: 每次随机关掉两成线索，它就没法只靠某几条蒙对。
quizzes.explainEn: Switch off a fifth of the clues each time and it can't lean on a few.

quizzes.q: 它能说短句了，靠的是什么？
quizzes.qEn: What lets it speak short sentences now?
quizzes.explain: 门控记忆让它记住一句话的开头，才能接上结尾。
quizzes.explainEn: Gated memory keeps the start of a sentence so it can finish it.

quizzes.q: 看图的脑子越深越差，为什么？
quizzes.qEn: Why does a deeper vision brain get worse?
quizzes.explain: 每一层都改一点，改着改着就走样了。给每层留条近路（残差）。
quizzes.explainEn: Every layer changes it a bit until it distorts. Give each layer a shortcut (residual).

quizzes.q: 为什么它翻译不了？
quizzes.qEn: Why can't it translate?
quizzes.explain: 它只会接着同一句往下说。先读完一句，再用另一种语言说出来（编码器 + 解码器）。
quizzes.explainEn: It can only continue the same sentence. Read one whole sentence, then say it in the other language.

quizzes.q: 长句一翻就乱，为什么？
quizzes.qEn: Why do long sentences come out garbled?
optionsEn: One slot can't hold the whole sentence
quizzes.explain: 它把整句压进一个小盒子，长了就丢细节。翻每个词时回头看原文（注意力）。
quizzes.explainEn: It squeezes the sentence into one small box and loses detail. Look back at the source per word (attention).

quizzes.q: 八张卡只有一张在忙，为什么？
quizzes.qEn: Eight cards, only one busy. Why?
options: 循环只能一个字一个字算
optionsEn: The loop goes word by word
quizzes.explain: 下一个字要等上一个字算完。去掉循环，每个字同时看所有字。
quizzes.explainEn: Each word waits for the last. Drop the loop and every word looks at all words at once.

quizzes.q: 便宜数据包让分数变低了，为什么？
quizzes.qEn: Cheap data lowered the score. Why?
quizzes.explain: 错题会被它当成对的学进去。先挑错，再喂。
quizzes.explainEn: It learns wrong labels as right. Clean first, then feed.

quizzes.q: 通读有什么不一样？
quizzes.qEn: What's different about reading everything?
options: 不用教答案，让它猜下一个字
optionsEn: No answers; it guesses the next word
quizzes.explain: 每句话的下一个字就是答案，所以什么文字都能拿来练。
quizzes.explainEn: The next word of every sentence is the answer, so any text can teach it.

quizzes.q: 难度降到一半就停了，缺什么？
quizzes.qEn: The difficulty stalls halfway. What's missing?
options: 规模：脑子和题都不够大
optionsEn: Scale: brain and data too small
quizzes.explain: 能力是规模到了才冒出来的。加脑容量、加题、换机房。
quizzes.explainEn: Abilities appear when scale arrives. More brain, more data, a server room.

quizzes.q: 问它问题，它接着出题，为什么？
quizzes.qEn: You ask; it writes more questions. Why?
quizzes.explain: 通读只教它往下接。再用「问题 + 好回答」教一遍，它才会回答（指令微调）。
quizzes.explainEn: Reading only teaches it to continue. Teach question-and-answer pairs (instruction tuning).

quizzes.q: 它总顺着你说，为什么？
quizzes.qEn: Why does it always agree with you?
optionsEn: You always pick the nice answer
quizzes.explain: 挑好答案时你选什么，它就学什么。想要实话，就挑实话。
quizzes.explainEn: It learns whatever you pick. Want honesty? Pick honesty.
